note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate/Log in/Sign up)
Table of contents -- renders: section headings defined by the article structure (e.g., Background, Terminology, Structure)
Page title bar -- renders: article title and language selector
Left navigation tabs -- renders: Article, Talk
Right navigation tabs -- renders: Read, View source, View history, Tools
Appearance settings -- renders: Font size, Width, Theme options
Site subtitle -- renders: 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Page footer -- renders: last modified date, copyright, license links, privacy policy, about, contact, mobile view
